name: deepline-quickstart
tagline_zh: 别急着看文档，先跑一个迷你案例。三分钟感受 Deepline 的魔力，比任何截图都直观。
tagline_en: Skip the docs, run a mini demo. Feel Deepline's magic in 3 minutes—more vivid than any screenshot.
desc_en: Run a quick Deepline demo recipe to show the user how Deepline works.
why_zh: 它把演示变成可执行的脚本，你亲手触发每个步骤，比被动看视频更能建立直觉。
why_en: Turns demos into runnable scripts you trigger yourself, building intuition faster than passive videos.
